featured_reviews.name: Bharatbhushan Singh
featured_reviews.review_text: I would give a 5 star rating to radhe stationery even though I have just visited the place once till date. I still remember I had my B-School Entrance exam scheduled on 29th Jan 2023 and I reached the center from Pune just 1.5 hours early and there I got to know that we were required to bring a colour print of Admit Card for exam. And then I rushed to the nearest Xerox/Stationery Shop to my exam center but all of them were closed because it was Sunday. I tried calling the owners of those stationery shops but none of them showed any interest in opening the shop early at 9 (just bcoz it was a weekend). But then one of the street vendor's told me suggested me to visit Radhe Stationery because they open their shop early especially to help the students on exam days. So I reached the Radhe Stationery Shop but it was closed so I tried to contact the owner and told her about my situation and she assured me that she'll reach the shop in 5 minutes and get give the printouts. I was actually shocked to see her there just to help me and give me my printouts. I am thankful to her because of the kindful and helpful gesture. Sometimes people think of monetary benefits involved in the work done by them but I was shocked to see the effort taken by the Owner of Radhe Shop as they just earned 10-15 rupees behind the work. I would surely suggest people should visit her shop and get their printing/xerox work done as well as purchase stationery.

featured_reviews.review_text: Amazing whole sale shop with large space inclusive of ground plus first floor. featured_reviews.name: lifeisliberty “lifeisliberty”
featured_reviews.review_text:

😒👉The only draw back is they charge 2% extra on credit cards.. So you must either pay in cash or through paytm or something..
